name: youtube_explainer
title: YouTube & explainer video
about: Retention-driven 16:9 YouTube video or explainer: 3-15s hook (Direct, Controversy, or Negative), open information loops, conversational human narration, inline facts/mechanisms, and a single-sentence CTA.

prompt_rules.story_analyst: Extract the core viewer promise, strongest counter-intuitive angles, and concrete facts, mechanisms, or examples that keep viewers watching without fluff.
prompt_rules.screenwriter: Open in the first 3-15 seconds with a Direct, Controversy, or Negative hook (NEVER 'Welcome back to the channel' or 'Hi guys'). Follow Hook -> Shock -> Validate -> Tease, open information loops that pull viewers across every section, attach concrete facts/mechanisms inline at the exact point they matter (never dumped at the end), write in plain conversational human language (understandable by a 12-year-old, zero AI buzzwords like 'folks', 'embarking', 'enchanting', 'delve', 'tapestry'), pair spoken narration with concrete filmable visual action, and finish with a single-sentence CTA (under 10 seconds, one ask only).
prompt_rules.script_doctor: Audit ruthlessly for first-15-second hook strength, open-loop retention across sections, conversational human voice (flag stiff AI phrasing), inline factual specificity, and a crisp single-sentence ending CTA.
prompt_rules.director: Design dynamic visual cutaways, B-roll, and visual analogies that reinforce every spoken beat so the screen never goes static.
prompt_rules.editor: Tight rhythm with zero dead air; visual pattern interrupt every 4-8 seconds; end cleanly right on the single-sentence CTA.
